svg.title: qestack
svg.desc: qestack: prove that AI-written tests catch bugs. AI-written tests pass through quality gates: trace, lint, red before green, mutation, hidden faults and an independent judge. The quality report says ACCEPT or ESCALATE, and a person reads it. Below: the QA library of skills for each test level, and the reviewer panel of independent personas.
